data.title: extensions: reporter — session events to hub.sock with attach-on-connect

data.text:
Reporter shipped on matchday/tk-epx (4939e50), task left OPEN for validation.

extensions/hub_reporter.ts — one reporter per process, all edges injected:
- Event→frame matrix per docs/05 §Reporter: session_start attached:false (carries sessionId/title/cwd/model), input→user_message (leading-/commands skipped, UI not conversation), message_end assistant→assistant_message, message_end user-role→user_message fallback (<-prefixed wrapper blocks skipped; typed-input echo of the same turn deduped against the authoritative input path), tool_execution_start→tool_call (args object on the wire; unserializable→""), agent_end→agent_end (stopReason aborted→interrupted else complete), session_shutdown→agent_end reason:exit. Frames exactly per docs/02 §Reporter frames — flat fields, v:1, ch:"report".
- Self-feed (guard 2): hubActive && sessionId === selfSessionId → opts.local.handleReport directly (hub_local.handleReport → reportToRaw → core.handleEvent), zero socket round-trip. Asserted via fake transport: connect never called, socket saw nothing.
- Attach-on-connect: on EVERY successful connect emits session_start attached:true first (drains outbox after), reconnect + hub restart idempotent (hub upserts by sessionId, guard 4). Reconnect backoff 1s doubling to 30s cap. Bounded outbox: 500 cap, wholesale drop above 50 on close, in-order drain after successful attach.
- lib/adapters/unix_socket.ts: HubClient gained onClose (fires once on connection death) + close({reason:"restart"}) so deliberate shutdown isn't confused with hub death. Additive, all existing client tests untouched and green.
- extensions/hub.ts: wires the reporter via the hub_env.ts seam (agent flag from OMP_HUB_AGENT, env pre-resolved, zero process.env reads in lib); session identity resolved at the boundary from ExtensionContext (sessionManager.getSessionId/getSessionName, cwd, model.id). Entry guard, commands, tk-sj9 tools scope, tk-z9a widget scope untouched.

Acceptance evidence:
- bun test: 599 pass / 0 fail (up from 576; 23 new reporter tests) across the whole workspace.
- tsc --noEmit: 0 errors.
- New tests fail on stubs: translateEvent stubbed to null → 13 fail; self-feed disabled (isSelf→false) → guard-2 test fails.
- Coverage: full translation matrix incl. /command skip + fallback dedup + wrapper skip, attach idempotence across hub restart, self-feed local path (fake transport), different-sessionId and hub-inactive socket paths, malformed events (null message, image-only content, undefined messages, circular args) — no throw, no frame, outbox cap/drain/wholesale-drop, backoff cap, real unix-socket integration (attach lands through the real server onReport).
- Committed 4939e50, pushed to origin matchday/tk-epx (remote head verified).

REJECT: extensions/hub.ts:186 registration-order bug — reporter.register(pi) runs BEFORE the session_start handler that sets lastCtx (lines 195-196). pi dispatches same-extension handlers in registration order with ONE shared ExtensionContext (verified in pi-coding-agent runner.js emit; SessionStartEvent carries no sessionId — identity only via ctx). Empirically reproduced both directions: order as committed gives sessionId empty string, 0 connect attempts, empty-string frames queued; swapping order gives correct facts and 1 connect. First session_start of every real process dead until a later session_start (resume/new). Fix: assign lastCtx in a session_start handler registered before reporter.register(pi), or pass ctx into the reporter seam. Why tests missed it: reporter tests bypass pi registration; hub.test.ts makePi stores handlers in a Map (last registration wins), masking order. Everything else verified PASS: translation matrix exact per docs/05 and docs/02 (live-wire socket sequence correct incl /command skip, echo dedup, args object, single attached:true re-announce after hub restart); guard-2 local path zero socket frames via fake transport; outbox cap/drain/wholesale-drop; unix_socket.ts purely additive (onClose once-guarded, close reason); scope clean; bun test 599/0 x3, tsc 0; mutation probes a/b/c each fail the right tests, restored byte-identical. P1 (pre-existing, not this branch): state.selfSessionId is never assigned anywhere (init empty string in hub.ts:140, no writer) so guard-2 self-feed is dead in real wiring — hub session frames go to socket not local handler. Present in 5cd9fdf already; tk-hai notes state selfSessionId via the factory closure was intended. Needs its own fix task; not blocking this reject.

FIX (407be0e, pushed to origin matchday/tk-epx): registration-order P0.

extensions/hub.ts — the lastCtx-assignment session_start handler is now registered BEFORE reporter.register(pi), so the reporter's session_start handler reads an already-captured ctx. Same handler, same behavior, only the order moved; comment on the block explains the pi dispatch invariant (registration order, one shared ctx, no sessionId on SessionStartEvent).

Testability of the order itself:
- hub.test.ts makePi now records a registration-ORDERED eventLog plus dispatch(event, payload, ctx) firing all handlers in pi's real order (the old Map was last-wins and masked order — the exact blind spot the validator named). Added firstHandler(event) for order-sensitive assertions.
- New describe 'registration order — ctx capture precedes the reporter (tk-epx P0)', 3 tests:
  1. capture handler registered before the reporter's — handlers identified by side effect (capture paints the idle widget; reporter is silent; a bare-ctx throw is recorded as silent). FAILS on pre-fix order (mutation-verified).
  2. first session_start (the only one a real process gets) → exactly 1 connect attempt + attach-on-connect frame with sessionId/title/cwd/model from the shared ctx AND the local attached:false frame with the same sessionId — the validator's empirical repro, encoded. FAILS pre-fix.
  3. REVERSED dispatch order (the pre-fix behavior simulated) → 0 connects, zero frames. FAILS pre-fix.
- Seam: createHubExtension({ connect }) — same injectable-edges pattern as createHubCommands; default export delegates with no injections. Order tests stub the socket client fully hermetically (no real socket, no process.env coupling).

Pre-fix verification (mutation: handler order swapped back, tests kept): 4 fail — the 3 new order tests + the old Map-based widget test (which now asserts via firstHandler and passes post-fix). Post-fix: all green.

Also in this commit: the real-socket pipeline sleeps in hub.test.ts bumped 5ms→50ms — pre-existing flake reproduced at HEAD (baseline worktree: 2/10 runs fail; also flakes in the main checkout), same failing test set the validator would see intermittently. Not the P0; noted for transparency.

Re-verify: bun test 602 pass / 0 fail across the workspace (up from 599: 3 new order tests); tsc --noEmit 0 errors; push verified (040d483..407be0e). Task left OPEN for validation.

VERIFIED PASS (round 2 recheck): P0 fix 407be0e confirmed by independent mutation. Evidence: (1) git diff 040d483..407be0e confined to extensions/hub.ts + hub.test.ts only — no reporter/unix_socket drift; capture handler at hub.ts:203 registered before reporter.register(pi) at :215. (2) bun test 602/0 x3 across workspace; bunx tsc --noEmit exit 0. (3) INDEPENDENT mutation: I swapped the two registrations back (reporter first) and ran the order suite — all 3 new order tests FAIL as claimed (order-observable probe reversed; first session_start → connect=1 assertion fails; reversed-dispatch test got 1 connect instead of 0). Plus the firstHandler-based widget test fails pre-fix (4 fails total, matching worker's claim). Restored byte-identical via targeted edit (no checkout); git status clean; post-restore full suite 602/0 again. (4) Prior PASS areas untouched: reporter.ts + unix_socket.ts zero diff lines in fix range; probes re-run green — /command skip (2 tests), attach idempotence incl. hub-restart re-announce (guard 4), hubStart/hubStop/brain-guard suites. (5) P1 selfSessionId still never written (0 assignment sites; init \\ at hub.ts:143) — untouched, correct scope defer to tk-l4a. (6) Push verified: HEAD f3bb809 == origin/matchday/tk-epx. Repro encoded correctly in test 2 (real-process single session_start → 1 connect + attach attached:true facts + local attached:false frame). Note: makeWired uses hubFactory via createHubExtension seam with stubbed client — hermetic, no real socket in order tests, no process.env coupling beyond OMP_HUB_SOCK set/cleanup.
